services.desc: Skydiving in the Poconos is an exhilarating experience for au pairs and camp counselors. The Poconos, known for its beautiful mountain scenery, offers the perfect backdrop for an adrenaline-pumping adventure. Skydiving allows participants to conquer their fears, experience an adrenaline rush, and enjoy breathtaking views from thousands of feet above the ground. This thrilling activity not only provides a memorable experience but also fosters personal growth and builds confidence. Whether it’s a group activity or a solo adventure, skydiving in the Poconos is an exciting opportunity for au pairs and camp counselors to create lasting memories and bond with fellow participants. blurb: Guests experience skydiving over the Pocono Mountains with expert instructors. The facility prioritizes safety with experienced instructors, top-of-the-line equipment, and quality airplanes and facilities. They offer tandem skydiving for first-timers, a skydiving school to learn solo jumping and earn a license, and opportunities for experienced jumpers.
